Subject: Initial vendor intake: tax ID, W-9 & VAT checklist

Hi Samantha —

Welcome and thanks for choosing Redwood for the integration work. Finance is kicking off the vendor setup so we can get POs and payments moving once the contract is signed. To speed things along, could you please return the items below by end of day Friday (6/25):

Required intake items:
- Completed vendor intake form (attached) — legal name, address, remit-to details
- Tax form: W-9 (for US entities) or W-8BEN-E (for foreign entities) PDF (signed)
- Company Tax ID / EIN or foreign tax number
- VAT registration certificate (if you invoice from an EU VAT entity)
- Bank details (bank name, account number, routing/IBAN, SWIFT) and remittance contact

Helpful, but optional:
- Certificate of insurance (if required under SOW)
- PO contact and billing email for invoices

Quick asks:
- Olive Labs appears to be a US entity per your website; if so please provide a signed W-9. If you’re billing from a non-US affiliate, send the appropriate W-8 and VAT docs.
- Please upload the documents to the HubSpot company record (link below) or reply to this thread with attachments.

HubSpot company link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/Olive-Labs
Attachment submitted with this email: Redwood_Vendor_Intake_Form.xlsx (stub)

Thanks — once we have the items above Marissa will create the vendor profile and Vivek will issue the PO. Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Jordan Blake
